name: Asuka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Asuka village emblem in maroon: a stylised flower-like device of a disc and curved petals.
history: Municipal flag of Asuka, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in April 1969.

features.role: Asuka village emblem — a stylised flower-like device of a disc and curved petals
